name: PSP Projects Ltd
title: PSP Projects Ltd - 540544 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue up 66% to INR1,115 cr on a 5.4% EBITDA margin after a INR29 cr Kashi ECL provision; FY27 guided at ~INR4,500 cr revenue and 7-8% EBITDA margin, with order book INR13,447 cr.

capex.quote: we can consider that minimum INR5,000 crores to INR6,000 crores of order inflow from the group side

guidance.quote: We'll stick to our INR4,500 crores revenue for the next year.
So we see that it should be within 60 days going forward.
I think it should be nil, so I'm expecting the company should be debt-free by this year
So this INR41 crores or INR45 crores of interest can be converted into profit, which can put us to 3% or 4%.
mostly it will be in the same range because again my experience and the operations and the size of the project

prior_guidance_check.quote: Earlier in the call we have mentioned INR4,000 to INR4,500 odd crores.
we were targeting closer to 8% to 8.5%

red_flags.label: ECL provision INR29 cr on Kashi unbilled revenue
red_flags.quote: company has decided to provide for the same

red_flags.label: Receivable days ~90-100; trade receivables INR928 cr
red_flags.quote: as it is now 90 to 100 days

red_flags.label: Group concentration: ~67% of order book Adani
red_flags.quote: out of which 67%, INR9,000 crores is Adani

red_flags.quote: we are still chasing on few things which has not been paid yet

evasions.quote: that will be materialized over a period of time
majorly what we are discussing today is about in the range of five to six months
